matching: Exact repository-relative path; no extension, glob, directory, prefix or basename exemption.
allowed_changes: Content hash, length and modification time only, always recorded with before/after values. Must remain same-identity regular single-link non-reparse OneNote TOC file with unchanged attributes and TOC signature.
all_other_checkpointed_files: Any fingerprint change or disappearance is STOP, including all other .onetoc2 files.
original: Any content, identity, attribute or membership change is STOP; Git status/diff must remain empty.
protected_33: All expected SHA256 values must match the accepted historical protected list independently of the metadata exception.
frozen_manifest: Exact authorized hash remains mandatory; evaluator-only, never transported or mounted.
runtime: Full approved runtime tree, wheel and Bubblewrap hashes must match; metadata exception does not apply.
new_artifacts: Exclusive creation only within separately declared new audit/checkpoint or future run write sets. No existing-file overwrite; record and hash new artifacts separately. Unrelated additions must not be silently accepted.
candidate_visibility: No metadata file or project directory mounted; metadata content never enters source/episode packets. Future changes to inputs/mounts require renewed audit.
implementation: Reference comparison implementation and synthetic tests exist only under this new audit directory. Existing candidate coordinator and historical checkpoints are untouched and will still enforce their old broad check.
authorization: Current user permits only provenance/integrity analysis, observation, new checkpoint and dry-run. No candidate execution is authorized.
